verdict.rationale: The `ccloud` CLI is documented to create, manage, and connect to CockroachDB Cloud clusters. The official Cloud MCP server lets AI tools explore live schemas, execute statements, insert rows, and run queries using OAuth or API key auth. Continuum also lets agents deploy virtual clusters, so every step of the story maps to a documented non-dashboard path. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of fetching the connection string programmatically, a documented non-interactive auth flow for `ccloud` (the quickstart is described as interactive), a documented management REST API (OpenAPI probe found nothing), and any hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent running the full flow.
